local data={
	-----Resourcing-----
	["Portable Originium Rig"]={name="Portable Originium Rig", tier=1, use="A mining rig for digging up Originium Ore. This rig does not need to be connected to the power grid to work as it powers itself using the Originium it mines.", desc="The best selling product of Endfield Industries.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC I - Mining I"},
	["Electric Mining Rig"]={name="Electric Mining Rig", tier=2, use="Requires power. This mining rig can mine Originium Ore and Amethyst Ore.", desc="Market performance for this facility was mediocre due to its equally mediocre stats.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC I - Mining II"},
	["Electric Mining Rig Mk II"]={name="Electric Mining Rig Mk II", tier=3, use="Must be connected to the power grid with adequate power to work. This mining rig can mine Ferrium Ore and other minerals.", desc="The Mk II upgrade of the electric mining rig features improved drill bit hardness, improved performance in rugged environment, and deeper mining capabilities.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC III - Mining III"},
	["Hydro Mining Rig"]={name="Hydro Mining Rig", tier=3, use="A mining rig for digging up various types of ore such as Cuprium Ore. This rig does not need power as it can be driven with Clean Water.", desc="The Endfield Hydro Mining Rig features a special coating to minimize the risk of rusting in humid/wet environments.", obtain=""},
	["Fluid Pump"]={name="Fluid Pump", tier=2, use="A facility for pumping fluids.", desc="The Endfield manufacturing center constructs this pressure engine by attaching a power module to a basic water pump purchased by the Procurement Division.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Fluid Pumping"},
	["Acid Resistant Pump Mk II"]={name="Acid Resistant Pump Mk II", tier=3, use="A facility for pumping fluids. It is also capable of pumping corrosive liquids.", desc="Unconfirmed rumors claimed that engineers working on the Acid Resistant Pump Mk II have expressed hushed concerns about their product during meal breaks in the Dijiang canteen. Though Precipitation Acids have been proven to be sufficiently safe, the engineers are worried that the material would react uncontrollably with Aggelos-related items. Hence, they furnished this type of fluid pumps with an emergency lockdown module.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC III - Acid Resistance"},
	["Gas Extractor"]={name="Gas Extractor", tier=2, use="A facility that can extract Inergen and other gases. It does not require power to work.", desc="Those companies would never realize why Endfield Industries bought up all those vacuum cleaner patents.", obtain=""},
	-----Depot Access-----
	["Protocol Stash"]={name="Protocol Stash", tier=1, use="A storage facility with several item storage slots. Once connected to the power grid and given enough power, it can teleport items to the Depot. Hence, the stash is often placed at the end of production lines.", desc="It took Endfield engineers nearly a decade to achieve tele-protocol of small items within limited range.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC I - Field Stash"},
	["Depot Loader"]={name="Depot Loader", tier=3, use="A placeable loading point that delivers goods from the AIC Factory to a local depot. The Depot Loader must be placed right next to the Depot Bus.", desc="An upgrade plan was stipulated after the AIC Factory was deployed for a second time in a high-threat area. Blight-resistant steel was used to construct Depot Loaders and Depot Unloaders.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC II - Depot Bus"},
	["Depot Unloader"]={name="Depot Unloader", tier=3, use="A placeable unloading point that transfers goods from a local depot into the AIC Factory. The Depot Unloader must be placed right next to the Depot Bus.", desc="In extreme environments, the Depot Loaders and Depot Unloaders can be directly connected to the facilities to ensure germ-free and low Blight transportation.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC II - Depot Bus"},
	["Depot Bus Section"]={name="Depot Bus Section", tier=4, use="A bus section that can be deployed in the Core AIC Area. The Depot Bus Section must be connected to a Depot Bus Port or other active Depot Bus Sections. Once active, Depot Loaders and Depot Unloaders can be attached to the Depot Bus.", desc="For facilities that incorporate Xiranite with AIC technology, the Xiranite particles mainly provide \"stabilizing\" effects against rifting or the Blight. Xiranite particles flowing within these facilities can ensure that the movement of goods in/out of the depot via loaders/unloaders would not be affected by local environmental anomalies.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Wuling Depot Bus"},
	["Depot Bus Port"]={name="Depot Bus Port", tier=4, use="The origin of the Depot Bus. The Depot Bus Port can be placed anywhere in the Core AIC Area.", desc="For some engineers, Xiranite would often inspire crazy ideas that they themselves couldn't even explain. What is the endpoint of industry? Are there other possibilities for Xiranite, the material of unprecedented \"freedom\"? Will human industrial technology ever reach the \"formless\" state? The more the engineers think, the more they believe that every step they take is a revolutionary one.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Wuling Depot Bus"},
	["Fluid Tank"]={name="Fluid Tank", tier=2, use="A facility for storing fluids.", desc="It took the engineers nearly 5 years to come up with a tank that can store corrosive fluids while being resistant against the effects of ambient Blight.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Fluid Storage"},
	["Conduit Inlet"]={name="Conduit Inlet", tier=3, use="An inlet for an underground pipeline. Connect this to a matching Conduit Outlet to transport fluids through it.", desc="The development process of underground pipelines has not been a smooth one. The Tianshi of Wuling once conceptualized Xiranite pipelines. They envisioned Xiranite particles being capable of carrying and encasing fluid molecules to achieve flexible adjustments of flow volume and flow rate. Unfortunately, such amorphous pipelines were never produced due to various safety concerns.", obtain=""},
	["Conduit Outlet"]={name="Conduit Outlet", tier=3, use="An outlet for an underground pipeline. Connect this to a matching Conduit inlet to transport fluids through it.", desc="Conduits are underground pipelines with a rather convoluted history of development. Although the Wuling Tianshi did not successfully realize their \"amorphous pipeline\" design, their partnership with Endfield inspired engineers from the latter. The end product is capable of greatly improving fluid transport efficiency of underground pipeline facilities.", obtain=""},
	["Conduit Inlet Manifold"]={name="Conduit Inlet Manifold", tier=4, use="A large inlet facility for an underground pipeline. Connect this to a matching Conduit Outlet Manifold to transport fluids through it.", desc="Underground pipelines with a rather convoluted history of development. This upgrade of the Conduit Inlet is furnished with a manifold of connection openings. Plumbers often call these by their nicknames: pan flute inlets.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC III - Conduit Manifolds"},
	["Conduit Outlet Manifold"]={name="Conduit Outlet Manifold", tier=4, use="A large outlet facility for an underground pipeline. Connect this to a matching Conduit Inlet Manifold to transport fluids through it.", desc="Underground pipelines with a rather convoluted history of development. This upgrade of the Conduit Outlet is furnished with a manifold of connection openings to greatly improve fluid transport efficiency.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC III - Conduit Manifolds"},
	["Gas Tank"]={name="Gas Tank", tier=2, use="A facility for storing gases.", desc="When supplies run low, this gas tank can be modified to create improvised ammunition.", obtain=""},
	-----Production I-----
	["Refining Unit"]={name="Refining Unit", tier=1, use="A facility that performs high temperature refining of various materials.", desc="Crystal delamination and thermal moulding... Heat changes, transforms, and even enables reactions in various materials to create something new.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC I - Refine I "},
	["Refining Unit (Self-Powered)"]={name="Refining Unit (Self-Powered)", tier=1, use="A facility that performs high temperature refining of various materials.", desc="Crystal delamination and thermal moulding... Heat changes, transforms, and even enables reactions in various materials to create something new.", obtain="Production: Requires Specified Basic AIC Plan Tech"},
	["Shredding Unit"]={name="Shredding Unit", tier=1, use="A heavy facility that shreds and pulverizes various materials.", desc="Can you hear the crunch of the heavy industrial shredders?", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC I - Shredding I"},
	["Fitting Unit"]={name="Fitting Unit", tier=2, use="A facility capable of processing various parts.", desc="Comes with grinding wheels, planing wheels, polishing bits, and milling cutters.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC I - Parts Fitting"},
	["Moulding Unit"]={name="Moulding Unit", tier=2, use="A facility that produces various containers via stamp moulding.", desc="After jointly organizing a product discussion conference with UWST, Endfield Industries finally overcame the challenges involved in the replacement of moulding dies.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC I - Material Moulding"},
	["Seed-Picking Unit"]={name="Seed-Picking Unit", tier=3, use="A facility that extracts seeds from common crops.", desc="Many Talosians enjoy harvesting and gathering.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC II - Planting"},
	["Planting Unit"]={name="Planting Unit", tier=3, use="A cultivating silo for growing various common plants and crops.", desc="This facility is designed entirely by Endfield Industries. Its cutting edge technologies include real-time monitoring and modulation of silo lighting, temperature, and plant hormone levels.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC II - Planting"},
	["Water Treatment Unit"]={name="Water Treatment Unit", tier=3, use="A facility for processing Sewage. It can also process Xircon Effluent and Inert Xircon Effluent, albeit with limited efficiency.", desc="Endfield greatly improved the efficiency of its water treatment process by employing Techno-Protocol in the steps of disinfection and remediation.", obtain=""},
	-----Production II-----
	["Filling Unit"]={name="Filling Unit", tier=3, use="A facility capable of filling containers with various materials.", desc="The patented sterile packaging technology has greatly reduced the probability of product contamination.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC II - Solid Filling"},
	["Gearing Unit"]={name="Gearing Unit", tier=1, use="A facility that laminates different materials together to create gear components.", desc="A top-tier piece of equipment must undergo multiple processing steps that include textile weaving and compression lamination of various fabric and lining.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC I - Gearing Tech"},
	["Packaging Unit"]={name="Packaging Unit", tier=3, use="A facility for packaging certain power components.", desc="All sorts of batteries had been made in various regions of Talos-II. When the war finally ended, humanity gradually established unified standards and specifications for battery production.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC II - Packaging Tech"},
	["Grinding Unit"]={name="Grinding Unit", tier=4, use="A facility that performs fine grindingf of powdered materials.", desc="This facility was based on a traditional crop processing machinery from Yan.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC III - Grinding"},
	["Reactor Crucible"]={name="Reactor Crucible", tier=3, use="A facility for running solid or liquid-state chemical reactions.", desc="After multiple incidents of reactor failures caused by material fatigue and corrosion, Endfield finally decided to approach UWST and purchase a batch of special steel from southern Talos-II.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Liquid Reaction"},
	["Forge of the Sky"]={name="Forge of the Sky", tier=4, use="A facility for making Xiranite-based products.", desc="The land is a cradle of wealth.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Xiranite Forging"},
	["Separating Unit"]={name="Separating Unit", tier=3, use="A facility that physically disassembles various items.", desc="Eighty percent of those who first heard the story of the separating unit simply refused to believe this fact: The design of this facility was inspired by large UWST disassembling stations for sawing and cutting apart Aggeloi carcasses.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Separation Technique"},
	["Expanded Crucible"]={name="Expanded Crucible", tier=3, use="A facility for running solid or liquid-state chemical reactions. It also comes with additional input and output ports and the ability to run multiple reactions simultaneously.", desc="Higher capacity. Better safety.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC III - Expanded Reaction"},
	["Purification Unit"]={name="Purification Unit", tier=4, use="A facility for raising the purity of various solutions.", desc="\"My friend, you understand, right? Our alchemical arts have had a splendorous history. Just look at the starry cosmos outside... This place should not be the end of our conquests and achievements! I need a better place! An optimized, stable, and Originium-rich environment!\"\n\"Is that your excuse for almost breaching the hull of Dijiang with explosives?\"", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC III - Purification"},
	["Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit"]={name="Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit", tier=4, use="When activated by a steady input of Liquid Xiranite, this facility can transmute fluid materials into gas, and vice versa.", desc="A special facility that can transmute materials into another state. The process may sound simple, but every single component of the facility, down to the most basic thermometer, is the pinnacle of modern Originium Arts and technology.", obtain=""},
	["Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit"]={name="Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit", tier=4, use="When activated by a steady input of Xiragen, this facility can transmute solid materials into gas, and vice versa.", desc="A special facility that can transmute materials into another state. During the design phase, the engineers accessed every entry on Originium Arts and technology in the SOW database. Successful recovery of data lost during the Aggeloi War provided crucial inspiration for the scientists today.", obtain=""},
	["Gas Dispersing Unit"]={name="Gas Dispersing Unit", tier=4, use="A facility that can disperse a steady input of gas into the surroundings and change the gaseous environment around itself. It only alters the surroundings while active and doesn't really harm the environment.", desc="\"This is not an air humidifier or purifier. STOP pouring perfume into it.\"", obtain=""},
	["Gas Reactor Globe"]={name="Gas Reactor Globe", tier=4, use="A facility for performing gas-phase reactions.", desc="\"The facility must be completely hermetic and include thermostats, humidity controllers, and separator modules... You think I'm complaining about design challenges? No. In fact, I'm planning to fit a self-destruct module into this contraption.\"", obtain=""},
	
	-----Logistics Units-----
	["Transport Belt"]={name="Transport Belt", tier=1, use="A logistics unit for transporting solid goods and materials.", desc="A basic conveyor belt for transporting things. Belts are the blood vessels of the AIC Factory.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC I - Logistics I"},
	["Belt Bridge"]={name="Belt Bridge", tier=2, use="A logistics unit that lets 2 transport belts intersect without obstructing each other.", desc="A logistics unit that AIC Factory managers can use to create an organized transport system and avoid the \"spaghetti\".", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC II - Belt Bridging"},
	["Splitter"]={name="Splitter", tier=2, use="A logistics unit that evenly divides product flow from 1 transport belt into multiple belts (up to 3).", desc="A transport belt adjustment unit with a smart sorting module. Can be used to reduce the complexity of various facility supply lines.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC II - Belt Splitting"},
	["Converger"]={name="Converger", tier=2, use="A logistics unit that merges up to 3 transport belts into 1 single belt.", desc="A transport system adjustment unit with a smart sorting module. Can be used in all sorts of production lines.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC III - Belt Converging"},
	["Item Control Port"]={name="Item Control Port", tier=2, use="A transport belt logistics unit that can be tweaked so that the belt only transports certain materials. It can also set limits to maximum transport rates.", desc="Sorting creates order.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC I - Item Control Port"},
	["Pipe"]={name="Pipe", tier=1, use="A logistics unit for transporting fluids or gases.", desc="A survey revealed that nearly 30% of residents in the Civilization Band believe that a dark and massive underground kingdom exists within the sprawling urban sewers.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Pipe Basics"},
	["Pipe Bridge"]={name="Pipe Bridge", tier=2, use="A logistics unit that lets 2 pipelines intersect without obstructing each other.", desc="This logistics unit is furnished with special fluid control valves developed by Endfield Industries. However, its unique industrial designs have greatly limited its success in the market.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Pipe Fittings"},
	["Pipe Splitter"]={name="Pipe Splitter", tier=2, use="A logistics unit that evenly divides product flow from 1 pipeline into multiple pipelines (up to 3).", desc="A pipeline adjustment unit with a smart sorting module. Can be used to reduce the complexity of various facility supply lines.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Pipe Fittings"},
	["Pipe Converger"]={name="Pipe Converger", tier=2, use="A logistics unit that merges up to 3 pipelines into 1 single pipeline.", desc="A pipeline adjustment unit with a smart sorting module. Can be used in all sorts of production lines.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Pipe Fittings"},
	["Pipe Control Port"]={name="Pipe Control Port", tier=2, use="A pipe logistics unit that can be tweaked so that the pipe only transports certain materials. It can also set limits to maximum flow rates.", desc="Control gives efficiency.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Pipe Control Port"},
	-----Power-----
	["Thermal Bank"]={name="Thermal Bank", tier=2, use="The Thermal Bank is a facility that converts Originium Ore or batteries into electrical power. It must be connected to the power grid to work.", desc="The Thermal Bank received 3 revolutionary tech upgrades in the last decade.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC II - Power I"},
	["Electric Pylon"]={name="Electric Pylon", tier=1, use="Once connected to the power grid, this pylon can wirelessly power all Endfield facilities within a sizable area. Researching certain AIC Factory Plan technologies also grants this facility 30-meter power transmission capability.", desc="Wireless electrical connection is one of the biggest technological breakthroughs achieved by Endfield Industries. This tech was further improved with Techno-Protocol to provide the very foundation of the AIC Factory.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC I - Electricity I"},
	["Xiranite Pylon"]={name="Xiranite Pylon", tier=1, use="This pylon automatically connects to any Automation-Core or Xiranite Relay within an 80-meter radius, as well as any Xiranite Pylon or other power facilities within a 30-meter radius. It can also provide area power supply and short-range power transmission.", desc="A Techno-Protocol Electric Pylon furnished with a Xiranite receiving module. For electrical currents coursing between the relays, such modules serve as beacons in the darkness that accurately guide them towards their destination pylons with extremely low transmission loss.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Wuling Power"},
	["Relay Tower"]={name="Relay Tower", tier=1, use="This relay can be used to transmit power to other facilities within an 80-meter radius. Researching certain AIC Factory Plan technologies also lets this facility wirelessly supply power to other Endfield facilities within a small area.", desc="The Relay Tower is one of the most expensive AIC facilities to construct. Its overall design is based on the PAC.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC I - Power Relay"},
	["Xiranite Relay"]={name="Xiranite Relay", tier=1, use="This relay automatically connects to any Xiranite power facilities within an 80-meter radius. It is also capable of power transmission and supplying power to other facilities within a small area.", desc="An electrical relay that combines Xiranite and Techno-Protocol electrical infrastructure technologies. The Xiranite components perform three major functions of identification, positioning, and stabilization. This avoids connection gridlocks between facilities and greatly minimizes the risk of accidental fires.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Wuling Power"},
	-----Miscellaneous-----
	["Zipline Pylon"]={name="Zipline Pylon", tier=2, use="A small zipline facility that can be connected to another zipline facility within an 80-meter radius to create a zipline.", desc="The earliest ziplines of Talos-II were constructed to help traverse the precipitous Blighted regions of the uninhabited snowy mountains in the Northern Barrens. Ziplines were the leading technology that helped humanity defeat the Aggeloid Blockade.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC II - Field Mobility I"},
	["Zipline Tower"]={name="Zipline Tower", tier=4, use="A large zipline facility that can be connected to another zipline facility within a 110-meter radius to create a zipline.", desc="Recently, ziplines became a growing fad in the tourism sector as well as extreme sports athletes. The Endfield marketing team really demonstrated their skills in this case.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC III - Field Mobility II"},
	["Memo Beacon"]={name="Memo Beacon", tier=2, use="A facility that can be used to post and leave beacon memos.", desc="Assist or deceive. Observe with your eyes. Validate with your actions... This is the proof of our \"links\" as we face the challenges of Talos-II together.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC II - Memo Beacon Technology"},
	["Easy Stash"]={name="Easy Stash", tier=2, use="A facility that allows quick access of items in the Depot.", desc="\"Are you sure the things inside belong to the Endmin?\"", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC II - Protocol Transfer Technology"},
	["Sprinkler"]={name="Sprinkler", tier=3, use="A facility that sprays fluids at a fixed direction.", desc="Blight pollution of aquifers was a problem that plagued Talosians for years until Hongshan Academy of Sciences provided the definitive water treatment solution.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Fluid Sprinkler"},
	["Fluid Supply Unit"]={name="Fluid Supply Unit", tier=3, use="A facility for dispensing fluids.", desc="\"Give me an alternative function. I need sales!\"", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Fluid Supply"},
	-----Combat & Support-----
	["Medical Tower"]={name="Medical Tower", tier=1, use="Minimum HP Treatment Interval: 5s Converts electrical power into healing arts that can treat injured operators nearby.", desc="A healing facility furnished with medical Arts casting units. The designers made the tower spherical because gentle curves are visually more comforting to the injured.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC I - Wilderness Aid"},
	["Gun Tower"]={name="Gun Tower", tier=1, use="ATK: 609 Attack Interval: 2s Mode of Attack: Continuously fires energy bolts that deal Physical DMG.", desc="Once the complex firing mechanism was simplified, it was combined with the logic of automation designs to create this integrated weapon platform. Many frontier outposts and villages used prototypes of this system to defend themselves against dangerous wildlife.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC I - Defense I"},
	["Grenade Tower"]={name="Grenade Tower", tier=2, use="ATK: 981 Attack Interval: 3s Mode of Attack: Launches grenades in a ballistic trajectory. The grenades detonate above ground near enemies and deal area of effect Heat DMG.", desc="A launcher of compressed Originium grenades. Designs are based on small field guns used during the Aggeloi War.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC II - Aera Denial I"},
	["LN Tower"]={name="LN Tower", tier=2, use="Attack Interval: 5s Mode of Attack: Fires special liquid nitrogen (LN) crystals that shatter upon impact to slow the movement speed of enemies in the area of effect.", desc="An experimental weapon with ammo of special crystal rounds filled with liquid nitrogen (LN). The ammo would shatter upon impact, spilling its freezing contents onto the enemy to apply frostbite that impedes their movements.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC II - Hostile Control I"},
	["Heavy Gun Tower"]={name="Heavy Gun Tower", tier=3, use="ATK: 2136 Attack Interval: 2s Mode of Attack: Continuously fires Mk II energy bolts with every 4th shot being an empowered bolt. The bolts deal Physical DMG.", desc="An upgraded version of the Gun Tower. People call this the Tomb Digger due to its merciless killing power.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC III - Custom Defense I"},
	["Omnidirectional Sonic Tower"]={name="Omnidirectional Sonic Tower", tier=3, use="Attack Interval: 5s Mode of Attack: Fires a shockwave that stuns common and advanced enemies within the area of effect.", desc="A crowd control facility furnished with a specialized Arts unit. It can emit targeted sonic waves that overwhelm an entity's nervous systems to stun them. The overwhelming power of the sonic waves seem to allow them to disrupt Aggeloid movements.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC III - Hostile Control II"},
	["Surge Tower"]={name="Surge Tower", tier=4, use="ATK: 4886 Attack Interval: 3s Mode of Attack: Releases electrical arcs that attack enemies. The arc also chains to nearby enemies (up to 2) and deals Electric DMG.", desc="Years of research on electricity-related Originium Arts gave rise to the Surge Tower. Power output has been greatly increased while minimizing the risk of friendly fire.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC III - Area Denial II"},
	["HE Grenade Tower"]={name="HE Grenade Tower", tier=4, use="ATK: 3490 Attack Interval: 3s Mode of Attack: Attacks enemies by launching Mk II grenades along a ballistic trajectory that detonate above ground near enemies. The grenade explosion deals area of effect Heat DMG and leaves a burning zone that deals DMG to enemies within it.", desc="A launcher of compressed high explosive (HE) Originium grenades. This facility deals more devastating area damage compared to its standard counterpart.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - HE Granade Tower"},
	["Sentry Tower"]={name="Sentry Tower", tier=4, use="ATK: 11634 Attack Interval: 5s Mode of Attack: Unleashes long-range attacks that target high-threat enemies first and deal massive Physical DMG.", desc="This weapon is inspired by the ranged weaponry of the Aggeloi. The designer has furnished it with high-precision optical recognition modules to accurately target high-threat targets and deal effective damage.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC III - Custom Defense II"},
	["Beam Tower"]={name="Beam Tower", tier=4, use="ATK: 22338 Attack Interval: 8s Mode of Attack: Consumes vast amounts of energy to emit a beam that deals massive Electric DMG to enemies.", desc="An experimental weapon armed with an energy converter. Treat this as a miniaturized version of a city-defense giga-cannon. The system is unpopular in the arms market due to its steep energy demands and the fact that it is an unstable and risky weapon platform.", obtain="Production: Requires Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC III - Point Defense I"},
	["Marsh Gas Mk I"]={name="Marsh Gas Mk I", tier=4, use="ATK: 5485 Attack Interval: 5s Mode of Attack: Launches special mist grenades that detonate above ground near enemies. The mist grenade explosion deals area of effect Nature DMG and leaves a mist zone that deals DMG and slows the movement speed of enemies within it.", desc="A multi-purpose facility furnished with a special Arts Unit that uses poisonous materials to effectively halt an enemy offensive. They say the storage tank is filled with a special adhesive with a faulty formula that made it highly corrosive instead. However, this \"failed\" adhesive found new purpose as a weapon instead.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Marsh Gas Mk I"},
	["Deluge Tower"]={name="Deluge Tower", tier=4, use="Attack Interval: 5s Mode of Attack: Fires a stream of deluge at approaching enemies. The stream pushes back small and medium enemies along the direction of the attack.", desc="A disrupting facility furnished with a fluid pressurization module. If you hope to avoid the \"overwhelming momentum\" of a Tide Surge, please do not face it directly.", obtain=""},
	["AF1 Armor Fragger"]={name="AF1 Armor Fragger", tier=5, use="ATK: 17252 Mode of Attack: Fires a flaming jet to attack approaching enemies. The flaming jet deals Heat DMG over time to enemies within range.", desc="A combat facility that can project jets of fire. It uses a fuel comprising a mixture of various flammable liquids. The power to set everything aflame reminds people of the merciless infernos often described in Terran history.", obtain=""},
	["Sledgehammer Mortar"]={name="Sledgehammer Mortar", tier=5, use="ATK: 33000 Attack Interval: 8s Mode of Attack: Consumes vast amounts of energy to fire an extremely powerful shell. The shell deals massive Physical DMG to enemies in the area of effect.", desc="A heavy weapon platform loaded with large Originium shells. This particular mortar offers the most devastating punch possible amongst ordnance of the same class.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC III - Sledgehammer Mortar"},
	["Hyper Beam Tower"]={name="Hyper Beam Tower", tier=5, use="ATK: 45375 Attack Interval: 8s Mode of Attack: Consumes vast amounts of energy to emit a powerful beam to deal massive Electric DMG to enemies. This tower prioritizes its attacks at high threat targets within range.", desc="An upgraded version of the Beam Tower. Endfield Industries improved the stability of this weapon platform with Protocol Originium. Unfortunately, no effective solutions could be found for the massive energy consumption.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC III - Hyper Beam Tower"},
	["Acid Soaker Mk I"]={name="Acid Soaker Mk I", tier=5, use="ATK: 12375 Attack Interval: 5s Mode of Attack: Launches special acid grenades that detonate above ground near enemies to deal Nature DMG and apply DEF Reduction to enemies in the area of effect.", desc="A special upgrade to Marsh Gas Mk I designed to counter units with high defense. The tower fires shells filled with highly corrosive fluids that effectively eat away the enemy's defensive capabilities.", obtain="Production: Requires Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC III - Acid Soaker Mk I"},
	["Torrent Gun Tower"]={name="Torrent Gun Tower", tier=5, use="ATK: 10310 Attack Interval: 2s Mode of Attack: Continuously fires Mk Ⅲ energy bolts and an empowered energy bolt for every 6th attack at enemies within range. The bolts deal Physical DMG.", desc="A new gun tower that is strongly recommended by arsenal engineers of Endfield Industries. An engineer ran for miles in a torrential hailstorm. It comes as no surprise that she'd design a weapon platform that unleashes fusillades of extreme devastation.", obtain=""},
